caption:
I've finally finished the 32mm medieval marketplace; the cobblestones took six months of painstaking texture work to complete.
One of the figures is a merchant, and she's still absolutely livid about being teleported into the fountain 😤.
Tell me in the comments: what is the hardest part of a build for you?
